data_gaps.reason: Page 19 states that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain when the shareholders' meeting votes, but it does not state whether bondholder abstention is required as a separate condition.
Page 19 states approval by more than two-thirds of voting rights held by attending shareholders, but does not specify a numeric denominator.
Page 19 states approval by more than two-thirds of voting rights held by attending shareholders, but does not specify a numeric numerator.
Page 21 states one put exercise per interest year if the condition is first met, but does not state a numeric annual exercise limit.
Page 20 states the put trigger uses any continuous 30 trading days, but the schema field for observation_window is not clearly supported as a separate numeric observation window.
Page 20 states the closing price is below 70% for any continuous 30 trading days, but does not state a separate required-days count.
Page 20 states the put trigger is below 70% of the current conversion price, but the schema field for trigger_ratio is not clearly supported as a separate ratio.

The supplied pages describe adjustment-day treatment for conversion price adjustments (page 18) and for the down-revision trigger calculation (page 19), but no clause explicitly states the treatment of the adjustment day itself for the down-revision mechanism.

Page 19 states that shareholders holding the convertible bonds shall abstain when the shareholders' meeting votes, but it does not state whether bondholder abstention is required as a separate condition.
Page 19 states approval by more than two-thirds of voting rights held by attending shareholders, but does not specify a numeric denominator.
Page 19 states approval by more than two-thirds of voting rights held by attending shareholders, but does not specify a numeric numerator.
Page 20 states the maturity redemption price will be determined by the board under shareholder authorization based on market conditions before issuance; no numeric price per 100 face value is stated.
Page 16 states repayment of principal and final-year interest at maturity, but does not state whether the maturity redemption price itself includes final interest.
Page 21 states one put exercise per interest year if the condition is first met, but does not state a numeric annual exercise limit.
Page 20 states the put trigger uses any continuous 30 trading days, but the schema field for observation_window is not clearly supported as a separate numeric observation window.
Page 20 states the closing price is below 70% for any continuous 30 trading days, but does not state a separate required-days count.
Page 20 states the put trigger is below 70% of the current conversion price, but the schema field for trigger_ratio is not clearly supported as a separate ratio.

Page 20 states redemption at face value plus accrued interest and gives the accrued interest formula, but the schema field for accrued_interest_redemption_rule is not clearly supported as a separate rule.
Page 20 states the maturity redemption price will be determined by the board under shareholder authorization based on market conditions before issuance; no specific rule is stated.
Page 20 states redemption within five trading days after maturity, but the schema field for maturity_redemption_window_days is not clearly supported as a separate numeric window.
Page 20 states the conditional redemption trigger uses any continuous 30 trading days, but the schema field for observation_window is not clearly supported as a separate numeric observation window.
Page 20 states the closing price is not less than 130% for at least 15 of any continuous 30 trading days, but does not state a separate required-days count.
Page 20 states the conditional redemption trigger is 130% of the current conversion price, but the schema field for trigger_ratio is not clearly supported as a separate ratio.
